item.title: Women in developing countries hardest hit by rising debt burden, UN research finds
item.description:
Study warns women face job losses and increased unpaid care duties as debt and conflict-driven turbulence force spending cuts

Women are hit hardest when the debt burden in developing countries rises, a trend expected to worsen as the war in the Middle East continues, UN research shows.

A report by experts from the UN Development Programme (UNDP), based on data from 85 countries gathered across three decades, shows women are disproportionately affected when debt repayments increase
